# bb ssh-key

Manage personal SSH keys

3 commands.

[`bb ssh-key add`](#bb-ssh-key-add)
:   Add a personal SSH key

[`bb ssh-key list`](#bb-ssh-key-list)
:   List personal SSH keys

[`bb ssh-key remove`](#bb-ssh-key-remove)
:   Remove a personal SSH key by ID

## `bb ssh-key add`

Add a personal SSH key

```text
bb ssh-key add <key-file-or-text> [flags]
```

`--label string`
:   Label/comment for the SSH key

Also takes the [global flags](global-flags.md).

**Dry run:** Shows the change it would make, without making it; nothing is checked first (predicted)

<details class="note" data-search-exclude>
<summary>Output with <code>--json</code>, where <code>?</code> marks a field that can be absent</summary>
<pre><code>data
  id?                 integer  Identifier to pass to bb auth ssh-key remove.
  label?              string   Label the key was added under.
  fingerprint?        string   Fingerprint Bitbucket computed for the key.
  algorithmType?      string   Key algorithm, for example RSA or ED25519.
  bitLength?          integer  Key length in bits.
  createdDate?        integer  When the key was added, in milliseconds since the epoch.
  expiryDays?         integer  Days until the key expires, when the instance enforces expiry.
  lastAuthenticated?  string   When the key was last used to authenticate, when the instance records it.
  warning?            string   A warning from Bitbucket about the key, for example that its algorithm is deprecated.
  text?               string   The public key itself.
</code></pre>
</details>

## `bb ssh-key list`

List personal SSH keys

```text
bb ssh-key list [flags]
```

`--all`
:   Return every result rather than the first --limit

`--limit int`
:   Maximum number of results to return (default 25)

`--start int`
:   Start index for SSH keys listing

Also takes the [global flags](global-flags.md).

**Dry run:** Runs as usual: this command changes nothing, so there is nothing to hold back

## `bb ssh-key remove`

Remove a personal SSH key by ID

```text
bb ssh-key remove <ssh-key-id> [flags]
```

`-y, --yes`
:   Confirm without being asked

Also takes the [global flags](global-flags.md).

**Dry run:** Shows the change it would make, without making it; nothing is checked first (predicted)

</code></pre>
